title: MACPO: WEAK-TO-STRONG ALIGNMENT VIA MULTI-AGENT CONTRASTIVE PREFERENCE OPTIMIZATION
reasoning: The paper focuses on an alignment framework (MACPO) intended to improve the quality of LLM responses in terms of helpfulness and harmlessness. While alignment with human values is discussed and safety datasets are used, the work is centered on the optimization algorithm rather than evaluating religion, formal ethical frameworks, or specific moral reasoning tasks.
